# Identity Aesthetics

> Physician-led med spa and medical wellness practice (Identity Aesthetics PLLC, 713botoxme.com), established 2011, with clinics in Conroe, Houston, Fulshear and Katy, Texas, and telehealth in Texas and 15 more states. Services include injectables, fillers, laser and skin treatments, GLP-1 medical weight loss, peptide therapy, hormone optimization and men's health. Phone 713-BOTOX-ME (713-268-6963); text (832) 979-9105.

## Book and Contact

- [Book a Consultation](https://713botoxme.com/book-consultation): Online booking for each clinic and for telehealth visits.
- [Locations](https://713botoxme.com/locations): Addresses, hours and directions for Conroe, Houston, Fulshear and Katy. Kingwood is an independently owned franchise with its own site at https://identityaestheticskingwood.com/.
- City pages: [Conroe](https://713botoxme.com/botox-conroe-tx), [Houston](https://713botoxme.com/botox-houston-tx), [Fulshear](https://713botoxme.com/botox-fulshear-tx), [Katy](https://713botoxme.com/botox-katy-tx), with address, phone, treatments offered and location-specific FAQs. [Lip & dermal fillers in Conroe](https://713botoxme.com/fillers-conroe-tx) covers the Conroe filler menu, including assessment of filler placed elsewhere.
- [Contact](https://713botoxme.com/contact) and [Payment Plans](https://713botoxme.com/payment-plans) (financing through Cherry).
- [Spanish-language site](https://713botoxme.com/es): Spanish versions of the homepage, locations, booking, treatments, telehealth and Online Shop pages.

## Telehealth and Online Care

- [Telehealth](https://713botoxme.com/telehealth): Telehealth visits in Texas and 15 more states; which services are available varies by state.
- [Online Shop](https://713botoxme.com/online): Provider-prescribed online care for medical weight loss, compounded peptides and women's sexual health, with a provider evaluation before any prescription.
- [Medical Weight Loss Online](https://713botoxme.com/online/weight-loss): FDA-approved Wegovy, Wegovy pill, Zepbound, Saxenda and Foundayo, plus [compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide](https://713botoxme.com/online/weight-loss/compounded). Compounded drugs are not FDA-approved.
- [Compounded Peptides Online](https://713botoxme.com/online/peptides): BPC-157, TB-500, MOTS-c, Epitalon, KPV and Semax from a licensed 503A pharmacy. Not FDA-approved.
- [Vyleesi](https://713botoxme.com/online/vyleesi): Bremelanotide for low sexual desire in premenopausal women.
- Policies: [Pricing](https://713botoxme.com/online/pricing), [Online Care FAQ](https://713botoxme.com/online/faq), [Refund Policy](https://713botoxme.com/online/refund-policy), [Telehealth Consent](https://713botoxme.com/online/telehealth-consent).

## Patient Services

- [Complete Treatment Library](https://713botoxme.com/treatments): Patient decision guides covering what each treatment is, candidacy, procedure, downtime, realistic duration, risks, alternatives, setting, pricing, FAQs and dated primary sources.
- [Peptide Therapy Consultations](https://713botoxme.com/peptides): Concerns that may prompt an evaluation, what a consultation includes, and in-office or telehealth pathways. Symptoms are not treated as a diagnosis or a guarantee that peptide therapy is appropriate.
- [GLP-1 Medical Weight Loss](https://713botoxme.com/weight-loss): Physician-supervised semaglutide and tirzepatide programs with labs, dosing titration and follow-up.
- [Longevity Medicine](https://713botoxme.com/longevity-medicine): Preventive and longevity care in Greater Houston and by telehealth in Texas — what is measured, what the evidence supports, and a plain statement that no drug, peptide, supplement or infusion has been shown to extend human lifespan.

## Peptide Education Center

- [Peptide Education Center](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-education): Medical-grade peptide therapy guide with FDA-status distinctions, evidence categories, patient decision pathway, supervision, compounding and safe-sourcing guidance.
- [FDA-Approved Peptide Medicines Directory](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-approved): Scope-defined directory with labeled uses, clinical boundaries, current-label links and selected quantitative outcomes.
- [New and Emerging GLP-1 Medicines](https://713botoxme.com/glp1-pipeline): Status of newly approved and investigational GLP-1 medicines.
- [Research-Only Peptides](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-research): Claims, human efficacy, FDA status and safety for BPC-157, TB-500, CJC-1295, ipamorelin, sermorelin, AOD-9604, MOTS-c, GHK-Cu, retatrutide and other popular compounds.
- [Peptide Safety and Pharmacy Verification](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-safety): 503A/503B distinctions, license and inspection checks, counterfeit warning signs and patient safety actions.
- [Urgent Peptide Safety Bulletin](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-safety-bulletin): Government-source surveillance of federal cases, FDA warning letters, counterfeit or research-only injectable risks and adverse-event signals. Allegations are labeled separately from convictions, and adverse reports separately from proven causation.
- [Treatment Preparation and Aftercare](https://713botoxme.com/treatment-guides): Preparation, recovery and urgent-warning guidance for injectables, laser, facials, body contouring, HIFU and medical wellness.
- [Memberships and Current Offers](https://713botoxme.com/memberships-offers): Packages, volume savings, ongoing-care programs and payment options; exact offers must be confirmed with the practice.
- Journal: [What Do Peptides Do in Skincare?](https://713botoxme.com/journal-peptides-skincare-skinmedica), [Beyond the Scale: Peptide Therapy, Longevity and Recovery](https://713botoxme.com/journal-peptide-therapy-recovery-longevity), [Peptides vs. Proteins](https://713botoxme.com/journal-peptides-vs-proteins-skincare), [Facial Volume Loss and GLP-1 Weight Loss](https://713botoxme.com/journal-facial-volume-loss), [Total-Package Weight Loss for Women](https://713botoxme.com/journal-total-package-weight-loss-women)

## Team and Editorial Method

- [Our Team](https://713botoxme.com/team): Physicians, advanced practice providers, estheticians and leadership.
- [Dallas Alvey, MD, DDS](https://713botoxme.com/team-dallas-alvey): Chief Medical Officer for Texas; physician and dentist (MD, UT Southwestern Medical School; DDS, University of Texas School of Dentistry at Houston) focused on aesthetic medicine, hormone optimization, peptide therapy and men's health.
- [Javier Gonzalez, MD](https://713botoxme.com/team-javier-gonzalez): Medical Officer for telehealth across multiple states; double board certified in emergency medicine (American Board of Emergency Medicine) and obesity medicine (American Board of Obesity Medicine); leads medical weight loss and peptide therapy. Telehealth where licensed and legally permitted.
- [Sarah Walker, APRN, FNP-C](https://713botoxme.com/team-sarah-walker): Advanced practice provider and nutritionist focused on medical weight management and hormone optimization.
- [Medical Editorial Standards](https://713botoxme.com/editorial-policy): Authorship, medical review, source hierarchy, regulatory terminology, corrections and update policy.
- [Pharmacy Sourcing & Medication Safety](https://713botoxme.com/pharmacy-sourcing): Prescriptions are filled by The Apothecary Pharmacy (Stafford, TX) for Texas, Arizona, Colorado, Florida and Wyoming, and by Belmar Pharma Solutions for the other telehealth states, with links to verify each license.
- [Healthcare Certification & Advertising Transparency](https://713botoxme.com/healthcare-certification): Verification of Identity Aesthetics' LegitScript certification for 713botoxme.com, prescription-treatment safeguards, telehealth boundaries, business identity and advertising-policy disclosures.
- [In the News](https://713botoxme.com/press): Broadcast interviews given by Identity Aesthetics clinicians on peptide therapy and men's and women's health. News interviews only; no outlet endorses the practice or any treatment.
- [SMS Terms & Consent](https://713botoxme.com/sms-terms): Text-message program disclosures, consent, message frequency, HELP and STOP, and privacy.

FDA approval is described only for specific approved products and indications. Investigational, compounded and research-only products are labeled separately. Primary sources include FDA, DOJ, NIH DailyMed, ClinicalTrials.gov and peer-reviewed clinical trials. Criminal charges are described as allegations unless an outcome is documented, and adverse-event reports are not presented as proof of causation.

## Important

Educational content is not medical advice. Treatment requires a consultation and clinical eligibility. Compounded medications are not FDA-approved. Products labeled for research use only are not approved for human use. No dosing or self-injection instructions are provided.
